title: Anthropic tool result not handling pdf files

linked_prs.title: feat (provider/anthropic): Add support for pdf files in tool result.
linked_prs.body:
## Background
Anthropic API supports handling of pdf files in the tool results which was not supported by AI SDK currently, so added the support for that.

## Summary
Added support for handling pdf files in tool response in anthropic provider.

## Manual Verification
Wrote a eg with a tool returning pdf file in tool result as base64 string.
